UserPayload.description:
UserPayload 是嵌入 JWT token 中的载荷（payload）结构。
用于识别当前会话的用户、设备以及该次会话的唯一标识。
这个接口替代了原来的 AuthTokenPayload 和 AuthenticatedUser 接口，
将用户认证信息和会话信息合并到一个统一的接口中。

post.summary: Verify email during registration
post.description:
Verify email during registration.

Validates the verification code sent to the user's email,
and returns a verification token valid for 30 minutes.

post.summary: Begin retailer registration
post.description:
Begin retailer registration.

Creates a PENDING_VERIFICATION user with RETAILER role
and sends a verification code to the provided email.

requestBody.description: - Contains email, language, timezone, and optional deepLink

post.summary: Complete retailer registration
post.description:
Complete retailer registration.

Verifies the email token, sets the user password and address,
and activates the account (status becomes ACTIVE).

requestBody.description: - Contains email, password, username, verification token, and address

post.summary: Begin wholesaler registration
post.description:
Begin wholesaler registration.

Creates a PENDING_VERIFICATION user with WHOLESALER role
and sends a verification code to the provided email.

requestBody.description: - Contains email, language, timezone, and optional deepLink

post.summary: Complete wholesaler registration
post.description:
Complete wholesaler registration.

Verifies the email token, sets the user password, company profile,
telephone, and address, and activates the account.

requestBody.description: - Contains email, password, username, company info, verification token, and address

post.summary: Send a verification code for password reset
post.description:
Send a verification code for password reset.

Sends a 6-digit verification code to the user's email.
Rate-limited to 1 request per 60 seconds.

post.summary: Verify the password reset code
post.description:
Verify the password reset code.

Validates the verification code sent to the user's email,
and returns a verification token for the subsequent reset step.
Rate-limited to 3 requests per 60 seconds.

post.summary: Reset the user's password
post.description:
Reset the user's password.

Consumes the verification token, updates the password,
and revokes all active sessions for the user.
Rate-limited to 1 request per 60 seconds.

requestBody.description: - Contains verification_id, token, and new password

post.summary: Refresh access token using a refresh token (native app flow)
post.description:
Refresh access token using a refresh token (native app flow).

Validates the refresh token, rotates it, and returns new access/refresh tokens.
Rate-limited to 2 requests per access token TTL period.

post.summary: Refresh access token using cookie-based refresh token (web browser flow)
post.description:
Refresh access token using cookie-based refresh token (web browser flow).

Reads the refresh token from httpOnly cookie, validates CSRF token from body,
rotates the cookie, and returns new access token with a new CSRF token.
Rate-limited to 2 requests per access token TTL period.

requestBody.description: - Contains CSRF token in refreshToken field

200.description: New access token and CSRF token

delete.description:

post.summary: Delete a specific session by providing the user's password
post.description:
Delete a specific session by providing the user's password.

Validates the user's password, deletes the specified session,
and clears the refresh token cookie if it matches the deleted session.
